description: Return free slots (default 30 min) in a date range [from,to], given the events + meetings of everyone involved. One person by default (user_id, or the caller). Pass user_ids to get the slots that suit ALL of them — busy is anything that is busy for anyone, which is what a two-way booking needs. Optional duration_min, agent_id (that agent's calendar instead of a person's). What this CANNOT do: read the calendar of an outside prospect — nobody has access to it. Slots proposed to a prospect are proposals, not commitments; the prospect confirms one, and only then is it booked.

from.description: Start of the search range (ISO date-time)

to.description: End of the search range (ISO date-time)

user_ids.description: Two or more people who all have to be free

name: find_free_time
